caption: A marble rolls across a table and hits a heavy steel ball at rest; the marble bounces back the way it came while the steel ball barely moves.

sa.check: A marble rolls across a table toward a heavy steel ball at rest.
The marble hits the steel ball.
The marble bounces back the way it came.
The approach comes first and the rebound follows.

pc.expect: At contact the marble reverses and rolls back slower, and the steel ball shifts at most slightly.
pc.fail: The steel ball shoots off; or the marble keeps going; or the marble leaves faster.
They pass through each other; or overlap; or sink into the table.

pc.expect: Motion changes only at the contact.
pc.fail: The marble reverses before contact; or the steel ball moves before; or the marble restarts.

pc.expect: Both are hard and the contact is a brief click.
pc.fail: A ball dents; or they stick; or a ball wobbles like jelly.
A ball vanishes; or a third appears; or they merge.

pc.expect: The balls and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The marble changes colour; or the steel ball changes size; or the table rearranges.
